name: Ahmad Samsuri Mokhtar
_note: M2 opposition-executive cohort: Menteri Besar of Terengganu since May 2018 (second term sworn 15 Aug 2023; period 'from' set to the second-term date). Added to populate the sub-national-executive class with opposition (PN) executives for the partisan-signal comparison. Objective spine (A5) plus Layer B editorial evidence on file; NO coder panel yet, so Layer B is unscored and below ranking validity. Anchor values pending an independent coder panel (minCodersToScore=3). Citations verified to exist via search; full text not opened (fetch restriction); require primary-source reconfirmation. ACCURACY NOTE: the February 2026 MACC abuse-of-power case concerns a Terengganu EXCO member, NOT Samsuri; his A5 is none-on-record. B5 left unscored (the female-performer policy is contested council policy, not a personal finding).

metrics.justification: No court charge, MACC charge, or conviction against Ahmad Samsuri personally is on record. A February 2026 MACC abuse-of-power case concerns a Terengganu state exco member, not the Menteri Besar; and in April 2025 the Inspector-General of Police publicly denied that Samsuri was under criminal surveillance, stating he is not a suspect. Recorded as the subject's own status: none on record.

citation.title: IGP: Samsuri not a criminal, not under surveillance

metrics.justification: During the late-2024 monsoon floods, Terengganu evacuee numbers peaked at 43,581 on 1 Dec 2024 (about 11,757 families across 306 relief centres); he ran the state response alongside a federal allocation and Malay Mail reported the state had recovered from the first wave by 7 Dec 2024, with two drownings recorded. Documented response with relatively rapid recovery (anchor 3).

citation.title: Terengganu fully recovers from first wave of monsoon floods, two drownings recorded

metrics.justification: His administration has a documented fiscal-discipline record: Terengganu repaid RM472.78 million in debt to the federal government over 2019-2022, and he tabled a Budget 2026 with an RM60 million surplus (revenue about RM1.998 billion), alongside a stated strategy to reduce dependency on oil royalties. Delivered, measurable fiscal strengthening (anchor 3).

citation.title: Ahmad Samsuri tables RM60 mln surplus in Terengganu Budget 2026

metrics.justification: After PN's clean sweep of all 32 state seats in August 2023, the Terengganu State Legislative Assembly convened on 1 Oct 2023 with no elected opposition representative for the first time in its history, so internal scrutiny now depends on backbench and public channels rather than an opposition bench. Worked within the institution without strengthening an external check (anchor 2).

citation.title: Terengganu state assembly convenes with no Opposition bloc

metrics.justification: Having defended a February 2024 domestic water-tariff hike as minimal and not burdensome, after public complaints over enforcement from August 2024 he ordered the state water company (SATU) to review the tariff and submit a new plan, and a revised tariff-setting mechanism took effect on 1 Aug 2025 (retaining the 20 cubic-metre subsidy for low-usage households). A reversal/adjustment under public pressure, explained on the record (anchor 3).

citation.title: Water tariff adjustment minimal, not burdensome, says Terengganu MB
